_meta.legalBasis: OR Art. 329a (Ferienanspruch: mind. 4 Wochen; bis zum vollendeten 20. Altersjahr 5 Wochen) und OR Art. 329d (Ferienlohn)
_meta.description: Standard Swiss payroll constants for hourly-wage conversion. The vacation-supplement percentages are the arithmetic consequence of the statutory vacation entitlement: pct = weeks / (52 - weeks), rounded to 2 dp as used universally in Swiss payroll practice.
_meta.note: 8.33% = 4/48, 10.64% = 5/47, 13.04% = 6/46. 13th-month supplement 8.33% = 1/12. These constants are timeless arithmetic over the OR entitlement, not year-specific rates. The standard full-time week varies by industry/GAV (40-42.5h); 42h is the common default. Cross-checked against SECO payroll guidance wording on 2026-07-15.
